welcome: BioNexus Hub practice terminal. Practice data is simulated (a 10 kb chromosome called chr1). Ready: sample.bam (sorted and indexed)
setup: fastp -i reads.fastq -o reads.trimmed.fastq --adapter_sequence AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCA --cut_right -h fastp.html -j fastp.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && bwa index reference.fasta 2>/dev/null && bwa mem reference.fasta reads.trimmed.fastq 2>/dev/null | samtools view -b -o aligned.bam && samtools sort -o sample.bam aligned.bam 2>/dev/null && samtools index sample.bam && rm aligned.bam reads.trimmed.fastq fastp.html fastp.json
